g.text: Roadster Flight Lab 3.11 | Manual roll and X

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526474

g.text: Each column starts upright at 80 m, stationary, G off, with identical response settings. Real actuator limits remain active.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526474

g.text: Constant-pressure numerical bench; supplied gas is counted. These cases do not establish feasibility with a finite tank.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Manual input is released after one integrated revolution; G is enabled 0.30 s later. Time axes include each method's full preparation and recovery.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: X returns to the initial height. Manual E + roll then G captures a higher hover: the maneuver pair ends at 80.04 m (X) and 101.48 m (manual).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Thrust is the sum of actual nozzle-force magnitudes, not vertical support force. The solid line ends when manual recovery criteria are met; it is not extended.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526474

g.text: Numerical fixed-step solver · 120 Hz statistics / 20 Hz curves · flat world · no WebGL, human control feel or FPS acceptance.
